reason: The 75.10 A^3 Z=1 cell and an O3-derived average framework are strongly supported by peak positions and a plausible whole-profile fit, but exact recovery is not established. No comparable Rwp was supplied, the trajectory constrained the oxygen framework instead of testing element-specific relaxations, and MnO6 and CoO6 are forced to be geometrically identical. Most importantly, the tested distinct Co/Mn orderings were essentially indistinguishable: after equal refinement the selected ordering had a 5.8976% profile residual versus 5.8996% for a scientifically plausible doubled-period ordering. That minute difference does not resolve the discrete ordering/supercell ambiguity, and the P-1 assignment is also only weakly distinguished from higher pseudosymmetry. Another attempt should explicitly refine and retain the surviving ordering/symmetry alternatives.
